plugins.description: 19 specialized agents (Atlas, Kai, Swift, Nova, Link, Forge, Pyra, Flux, Shield, Sage, Morgan, Diana, Pixel, Apex, Sentinel, Scroll, Echo, Neuron, Pipeline) and 49 skills — 35 first-party workflow skills for feature development, PR creation, code review, health checks and releases, plus 14 vendored Apache-2.0 agent skills from Google (android-*) and JetBrains (kotlin-*) that install alongside them. Ships 19 rule files: 11 shared rules copied into your repo by /setup-repo, and 8 coding standards read on demand from the plugin.
